item.text:
Introduced a synchronous event bus and moved simulation coordination onto it. [`SimulationEventBus.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/SimulationEventBus.java:11), [`SimulationEvent.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/SimulationEvent.java:6), and [`SimulationEvents.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/SimulationEvents.java:6) now define the event layer for step start/completion, reset, weather requests/changes, time-of-day changes, and organism birth/death. [`Simulator.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/Simulator.java:92) now publishes step/reset/lifecycle events instead of directly invoking the rules engine and display on each loop iteration.

The environment and UI now react through subscriptions. [`SimulationRulesEngine.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/SimulationRulesEngine.java:16) subscribes to step/reset/weather-request events and emits weather/time-of-day change events, while [`SwingSimulationView.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/SwingSimulationView.java:37) and [`HeadlessSimulationView.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/HeadlessSimulationView.java:17) subscribe to state events instead of being called directly. Birth and death events now originate inside [`Organism.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/Organism.java:32), which required threading the event bus through the organism factories and constructors via [`OrganismFactory.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/OrganismFactory.java:6), [`OrganismAttributes.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/OrganismAttributes.java:73), [`PopulationRule.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/PopulationRule.java:28), and [`SimulationContainer.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R012_module_java/SimulationContainer.java:35).
